hunks.lead: On Facebook, we will seek further information before taking actions ranging from temporarily restricting to permanently disabling profiles or accounts if you:
lines: We allow accounts dedicated to fan sentiment, humor, parody, satire, criticism, commentary, and opinion. The account must make its unofficial status abundantly clear at minimum in the account name and ideally elsewhere on the profile, such as in the profile photo or bio (e.g., by including "fan page" in the handle/name). Accounts that do not clearly disclose their unofficial nature may be restricted or removed.
